response.sql: WITH by_source AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / NULLIF(s.boxx, 0)) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference, SUM(s.aream2) / NULLIF(SUM(s.volm3), 0) AS area_to_volume_ratio FROM projects AS p JOIN scanspatial AS s ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), compared AS (SELECT by_source.*, AVG(area_to_volume_ratio) OVER () AS cross_source_average FROM by_source) SELECT fundflux, avg_y_vs_x_difference, area_to_volume_ratio, area_to_volume_ratio - cross_source_average AS amount_above_average FROM compared WHERE area_to_volume_ratio > cross_source_average;

assumptions.assumption: Missing funding sources are excluded. Zero denominators produce NULL ratios, which are omitted from averages.
